fields.mechanism: Reinforcement of the device structure to maintain expansion and prevent compression-induced flow impairment.
fields.intervention: Integrate a high-modulus braided reinforcement layer within the multi-lumen catheter wall to resist external compression and prevent lumen collapse without increasing the outer profile diameter.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction of pressure loss by maintaining patent lumen cross-sectional area under physiological loading conditions, preventing the flow restriction caused by wall deformation.
fields.falsification_test: Subject the reinforced catheter to radial compression forces equivalent to 200 mmHg in a flow loop; failure is defined as a pressure drop increase exceeding 10% compared to the uncompressed state.
fields.mechanism_source_span: In vivo, a reinforced prototype could be positioned across the aortic valve, but myocardial compression impaired inflow expansion and LV unloading

span_derivation.basis: shared content terms between span and mechanism+intervention; ratio < 0.20 = SPAN_UNDERIVED (the quoted span does not contain the mechanism's vocabulary)

fields.mechanism: Structural reinforcement of the lumen wall to prevent compression-induced flow restriction.
fields.intervention: Integrate a helical or braided structural reinforcement matrix within the multi-lumen catheter tubing wall to resist external compressive forces and maintain lumen patency without increasing the outer profile diameter.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in pressure loss by preventing lumen collapse or deformation under physiological or operational loads, thereby maintaining consistent flow rates within the existing catheter footprint.
fields.falsification_test: Subject the reinforced multi-lumen catheter to radial compression loads equivalent to maximum expected in-vivo tissue pressure while measuring differential pressure across the lumens; failure is defined as a pressure drop exceeding the baseline unreinforced specification under load.
